rulings.decisions/ci-job-caps: Owner, 2026-11-01 18:44 CST: each owner repo raises its job caps generously, as a stopgap, until its time-pinned tests are gone. Owner, 2026-10-27, roadmap step c95 (the cap rule): a full CI run is red only when something is broken, never because a job ran out of time. The target is a slowest run under 80% of the cap.
